figures.finding: American Samoa follows US federal labour law, and its minimum wages are set by industry, not by occupation, so a screenwriter employed there by a film or television employer falls under 'Miscellaneous Activities', USD 5.80 an hour from 30 September 2024. No writers' agreement or guild rate specific to the territory was found; whether the Fair Labor Standards Act's exemptions reach a salaried screenwriter was not checked.
